description: Utility helper functions for reading and formatting 'Credits' values from API responses, including functions to extract credits used from various API response formats and to format numerical credits into locale-aware string representations.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extract credits used from a details response, preferring camelCase and falling back to snake_case. Returns null if neither exists or not a finite number.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Format number with locale-aware formatting and fixed precision rules to avoid scientific notation and keep UI consistent.
